body:
Lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-08, revised 23:22Z). POST /api/sessions/ID/kill, which the UI trash also calls, removes the session AND its whole delegation-child subtree (src/delegations.rs:3887). This is INTENDED: Greg, 'Jak usuwam sesje to razem z delegacjami. Nie chce jakiejs historii.' and 'Juz pytamy o potwiedzenie. Nie potrzebujemy info o delegacjach.' So no count, warning or extra confirmation is wanted, and no recovery of removed sessions. Removing session-8581 removed 634 sessions and he confirmed that matched his expectation.

My error stands as a method lesson: I told him 'nie usunęło innych' was at risk only after acting, because my pre-check filtered /api/state delegations on parentSessionId, a field that projection doesn't carry, so its zero proved nothing, and I hadn't read the whole code path. Rules: before an irreversible act, read the whole path invoked; show a zero-returning check could return non-zero; state the blast radius first. Greg didn't ask for more process around removal; this is about how I check.
